components.name: Alert
components.summary: A compact raised notice that sits inside content — an icon, one line of text, an optional action — with an accent version that glows to ask for attention.

components.name: ArrowButton

components.name: Banner
components.summary: A notice across the top of a screen, with optional actions on the right.

components.name: Chip
components.summary: A small label pill on card captions — the comic type ("Manhwa") or a score ("★ 8.5").

components.name: Droplet
components.summary: The clear glass pill that marks a selection everywhere in Beako: mostly transparent, a faint rim, a soft shadow and no bright glint.

components.name: DropletSegmented
components.summary: A segmented switch whose selection is a glass droplet that slides between options — 7d · 1m · 3m, Hot · New.

components.name: GlassButton
components.summary: A pill button on glass; primary makes it the solid, high-emphasis action.

components.name: GlassIconButton
components.summary: An icon-only circular glass button with an accessible name.

components.name: GlassSurface
components.summary: The floating liquid-glass panel: what is behind is blurred under a light dark tint, with a 1 px rim that fades from rim-bright to rim, and a shadow-glass drop…

components.name: GlassTextField
components.summary: A labelled single-line text box on glass; secret hides what is typed.

components.name: IconToggleGroup
components.summary: An icon-only single choice on a small raised surface card: the chosen icon is full text, the others sit at text-muted and 70% opacity, and the change cross-fad…

components.name: MorphSelect
components.summary: A small pill trigger ("This week ⌄") that grows out of itself into a popover — an action on top, a two-way segmented choice below — and shrinks back into the p…

components.name: NavPanel
components.summary: The full glass menu: logo and collapse control, a search with its shortcut, sections ("Main", "Accounts") with counts and add buttons, an expandable group whos…

components.name: RankChip
components.summary: The position badge on ranked shelves: gold, silver and bronze for the top three, dark glass below.

components.name: ResultRow
components.summary: One search result as a glass row: rank, cover, title, details and description.

components.name: SearchField
components.summary: The pill search box at the top of Browse and Search.

components.name: Sidebar
components.summary: The floating glass navigation pill down the left edge: account rings on top, then Library · Latest updates · Browse · Reading history · More.

components.name: Skeleton
components.summary: A flat grey block (chip-rim, 8% white) shown where content is still loading.

components.name: SoftField
components.summary: A soft (neumorphic) search field: it is the same colour as the ground under it and is shaped only by shadow-soft-raised (light top-left, dark bottom-right), wi…

components.name: StateMessage
components.summary: A centred message for empty and error states, with an optional action below.

components.name: Tabs
components.summary: Text tabs on a 1 px rim hairline; the current tab is text with a 2 px accent underline that slides (and stretches to the label's width) on the droplet spring.

components.name: TitleCard
components.summary: The glass caption card: a 2:3 cover with a frosted caption, an optional rank chip or unread badge, and a small lift on hover.

components.name: ToggleIconButton
components.summary: A round on/off button: off is an accent-fill circle with a plus; on, an ink-fill circle wipes down from the top and the plus turns into a minus.

components.name: TriStateChip
components.summary: A tag chip with three states — not selected, included (✓) and excluded (✕ with a strikethrough) — so state is never shown by colour alone.
